title: PGx canonical dataset build manifest
description: The machine-readable account of one sealed canonical build (WP-07). It records which raw snapshot it was derived from, under which rule versions, which identity allocation supplied its UUIDs, and the digest of every file in the build directory. A canonical build is a build product: it is not a quality approval, not a publication and not a release, and the dataset it describes stays BUILDING until a named human records a decision. Counts under source_observed_axes describe what the snapshot mentions; they are not validated coverage, clinical coverage, supported treatment, safe alternatives or executable pharmacogenetic rules.

canonical_build_layout_version.description: Layout shape version. A build declaring another version is refused rather than silently upgraded.

dataset_public_id.description: The dataset this build belongs to.

canonical_build_key.description: Dataset public id and the first 16 hex characters of the content hash. Two builds of the same snapshot under the same rules share it.

content_hash.description: Digest of everything two builds of one snapshot must agree on. Excludes built_at and every per-run count.

snapshot_manifest_hash.description: The raw snapshot manifest this build was derived from.

snapshot_content_hash.description: The raw snapshot's aggregate content hash.

snapshot_state.description: The snapshot's state at build time. A QUARANTINED snapshot may be built from and may not pass a quality check.

snapshot_complete.description: Whether the raw snapshot asserts completeness relative to the upstream source. False for a legacy import, where completeness is unknown and is not inferred from the fact that every file present was copied.

rule_versions.description: Every rule version this build depended on. A build is only comparable with one produced under the same set.

allocation_content_hash.description: Digest of the identity allocation this build read its UUIDs from. Identity is allocated explicitly and never derived from a name.

identity_minted_count.description: Identities this run created. Zero on a reproduction. A per-run fact, excluded from content_hash.

built_at.description: When this run wrote the build. Provenance, not content: excluded from content_hash.

dataset_lifecycle_state.description: Always BUILDING. Nothing in WP-07 can transition a dataset; a quality decision is recorded by a named human.

summary.description: Counts, every one derived from the build's own artifacts. A separate re-count reads the sealed files back and a disagreement is a blocking data-quality finding.

source_observed_axes.description: What the snapshot was observed to mention. Deliberately not called coverage.

files.description: SHA-256 of every file in the build directory, keyed by name.
